nodes.name: Validate Request
nodes.notes:
Purpose:
Ensure query exists.
Ensure query is not empty.
Trim whitespace.
Set default top_k if missing.
Preserve every other incoming field.
Stop the workflow immediately if the request is invalid.

nodes.name: Normalize Query
nodes.notes: The objective of this node is NOT to change the meaning of the user's question. Its purpose is to produce a clean, consistent version of the query so the embedding model receives standardized input. NEVER overwrite the original query, so I created another field "normalized_query".

nodes.name: Generate Request Metadata
nodes.notes:
Generate system metadata for the request. This metadata is used for:

1. tracing requests through all workflows
2. debugging
3. logging
4. analytics
5. future distributed processing
NOTE:
This node does not modify the query.

nodes.name: Generate Query Embedding
nodes.notes: This node converts the user's normalized_query into a dense vector using the same embedding model that was used when indexing documents in Knowledge Intake Agent (workflow-2).

nodes.name: Prepare Qdrant Search Payload
nodes.notes: Building the JSON payload exactly as Qdrant expects for vector search.

nodes.name: Qdrant Vector Search
nodes.notes: Search the knowledge_base collection using the query embedding and retrieve the most semantically similar chunks.

nodes.name: Retrieval Post-Processor
nodes.notes:
Convert the raw Qdrant response into a clean, standardized retrieval object that the rest of the RAG pipeline can consume.

This node:

1. extracts only useful fields
2. removes vectors and API metadata
3. preserves similarity scores
4. packages everything into a consistent structure

nodes.name: Similarity Threshold Filter
nodes.notes:
After retrieving candidates, discard chunks below a minimum similarity score.

Example:

Score >= 0.75  → Keep
Score < 0.75   → Ignore

Only sufficiently relevant chunks continue through the pipeline.

Filtering::::
SUCCESS → Generate answer from retrieved knowledge.
NO_MATCH → Tell the user no relevant information was found.
EMPTY_COLLECTION → Tell the administrator the knowledge base has not been populated.
